description: One row per related place, with its explicit relation provenance (Google carousel or same-category nearby), canonical and legacy identifiers, category, rating, reviews, contacts, coordinates, image, straight-line distance, and a back-reference to the source place.

similarPlaces.description: Each item is one related place. relationMode says whether Google recommended it (googleCarousel) or it was found nearby in the same category (sameCategoryNearby). Fields Google does not publish are omitted.
